status: Mapping corrected before outcome analysis; reuse earlier responses only if full request hashes match
purpose: Internal replication; these public data have already informed earlier analyses. No fresh external validation claim.

matching.income_mapping: Only the shared $100,000 boundary; do not infer finer incomes
matching.gender_mapping: Source binary sex labels mapped to Man/Woman for this operational comparison; not a claim about gender identity
matching.region: Native North America pinned; common US survey context. No US subregion matching.
matching.cloud_boundary: Only native DAG records plus public questions. Aggregate demographic quotas, no individual source profiles, IDs or answers.

probability_decoder: Reject out-of-range values or absolute sum error > 0.02; normalize accepted rounding errors to sum 1

scoring.matching: 13 question TV errors averaged equally; fixed human reference. No individual accuracy for synthetic profiles.
scoring.origin: Four original attribute-choice proportion errors equally averaged
scoring.packaging: 16 card-level A/B/neither TV errors equally averaged; opt-out recall and Brier reported separately
scoring.replicates: Score each generation repetition and the averaged probabilities; show all three, no best-run selection
scoring.bootstrap: 2000 samples, respondents clustered for products; fixed demographic cells for synthesis. Coarse versus matched cohorts resampled independently; same synthetic cohort paired across models and trait conditions.
scoring.uncertainty: Intervals conditional on three generated repetitions and fixed reference; not full survey-design or deployment uncertainty
scoring.adoption: Gain >= 2pp and bootstrap lower bound > 0 and positive gain in all three repetitions; tasks reported separately
scoring.completion: >=98% in every cell and repetition, comparisons on common completed IDs; never route real profiles to cloud
